purpose: Operationalize the empirical sector bridge and firm-liquidity evidence without converting raw observations into canonical targets.

sectorBridgeMethod.allocationRule: Classify candidate products by observed use shares rather than producer-industry identity alone; retain mixed-use products as weighted or unresolved rather than forcing a single model sector.

modelSectorOperationalRules.rule: Begin from primary-extraction activities (ISIC A/B), then preserve agriculture/mining heterogeneity; do not average into one target until a reference-economy weighting contract exists.
Admit product groups only when intermediate-consumption use share is dominant under the chosen country-year SUT; mixed-use products remain weighted/unresolved.
Admit product groups only when gross-capital-formation use is material and semantics match durable productive capital; investment classification overrides producer-industry shorthand.
Admit product groups only when household-final-consumption use is dominant and the model actually represents that consumption category; services are not silently included.

sectorMetricsAfterBridge: value added per worker or hour

evidencePriority: official business balance-sheet or sector-account statistics
stress-event evidence as lower-tier boundary evidence
liquidityEvidenceProtocol.steadyStateRule: No stress-event cash runway observation may define the steady-state target by itself.
liquidityEvidenceProtocol.sizeClassRule: Micro/small/medium/large firm evidence must not be pooled without explicit weighting.
liquidityEvidenceProtocol.industryRule: Industry liquidity differences must be preserved when material.

officialLiquiditySources.role: cross-country SME finance conditions, payment delay, credit conditions and distress context
country-specific short-term SME payment-delay evidence; 2022 average payment delay reported at 9.2 days
officialLiquiditySources.mappingNote: Payment delay is not accounts-payable days and is not a universal trade-credit term.

officialLiquiditySources.source: Monetary Policy Report 2020 small-business liquidity discussion
officialLiquiditySources.role: stress-boundary evidence for low cash resilience

admissionGateForNumericRanges: stock-flow denominator compatible with model variable
sector bridge passed for sectoral metric
at least two independent official evidence families where feasible
stress-event evidence not used as sole steady-state center
shadow-only validation planned before canonical proposal
